died.name: Leonardo da Vinci
died.cause: to King Francis I of France
died.last_words: I have offended God and mankind because my work did not reach the quality it should have.

died.name: William Beckford
died.cause: in a message to his daughter

died.name: José Abad Santos
died.desc: fifth Chief Justice of the Philippines, Acting President of the Commonwealth of the Philippines
died.cause: bidding farewell to his son Pepito prior to execution by occupying Japanese forces. Abad Santos subsequently refused to be blindfolded for his execution and he declined the final cigarette which was offered to him
died.last_words: Take good care of your mother, your brother, and sisters. Tell them to live up to our name. God bless you, my son.

died.name: Nancy Astor, Viscountess Astor
died.cause: awakening on her deathbed to see her entire family around her. (Astor died 17 days before her birthday.)
died.last_words: Am I dying or is this my birthday?

died.name: Christina Marie Riggs
died.cause: prior to execution by lethal injection for killing her two young children
died.last_words: There is no way words can express how sorry I am for taking the lives of my babies. Now I can be with my babies, as I always intended. I love you my babies.

born.name: John André
born.cause: prior to being hanged as a spy by the Continental Army
born.last_words: I pray you to bear me witness that I meet my fate like a brave man. It will be but a momentary pang.

born.name: Jesse William Lazear
born.cause: The 34-year-old American physician was convinced that mosquitoes were carriers for yellow fever. He allowed himself to be bitten by multiple mosquitoes and died days later from the disease.

born.name: Manfred von Richthofen
born.cause: mortally wounded at the Fourth Battle of Ypres
